subject.title: Feature Request: Anthropic Context Management Beta Passthrough

question: Should the remaining Anthropic context-management work be kept as one umbrella item, or split into provider-native compaction, context editing, and Memory Tool/plugin-seam tracks?
rationale: The source gap is clear, but the permanent public config/API shape and filesystem-memory security boundary require maintainer intent before implementation.

options.title: Split and keep provider-owned opt-ins
options.body: Use the focused compaction issue for server-side compaction, keep this issue for context editing and shared Anthropic context-management design, and leave Memory Tool implementation to a plugin unless core seams are missing.

options.title: Keep one umbrella tracker
options.body: Use this issue as the single design item for compaction, context editing, beta payloads, and Memory Tool, accepting that implementation will be broad and harder to review incrementally.

options.title: Close after moving all slices
options.body: Open or designate separate canonical items for every remaining slice, then close this umbrella as superseded once no unique context remains.

recommendation.title: Split and keep provider-owned opt-ins
recommendation.body: Use the focused compaction issue for server-side compaction, keep this issue for context editing and shared Anthropic context-management design, and leave Memory Tool implementation to a plugin unless core seams are missing.

likelyOwner.reason: They have the strongest current history across the active Anthropic transport/wrapper and the adjacent OpenAI server-side compaction precedent.
